description: Change how often Canvas emails or texts you about one kind of event, e.g. "grading" only weekly, or "announcement" immediately. Only affects your own notifications. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true. Apps that can ask the user directly will show a confirmation instead.]

channel_id.description: Communication channel ID (numeric string). Get it from get_communication_channels.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

name: update_notification_preference
title: Update Notification Preference
